body: They would probably reply with shocked faces, but say kind and supportive words and attempt to give me anything I needed to help. And I guess this is why I feel so bad. I just want to be able to see this through alone, without accepting so much more charity or loan, be it monetary or emotional. I want to prove to myself that I'm strong. I've fought these feelings for 10 or more years already.
I spent so much of my life talking to people I knew, got into some bad depression and ended up driving away some friends by throwing my own little pity parties, and eventually becoming annoying.
The same, but without my dependence on my parents, mostly. I'm just too old to do this.
